title: Size and personnel of the Harmon's Dreamland band
summary: Levy lists the Dreamland band: three saxes, two trumpets, two trombones, and a rhythm section with Dick Curry on drums. The tape ends in garbled fragments.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
